newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy official clarifies 1998 spending cut - radio.
newsitem.headline: Italy official clarifies 1998 spending cut - radio.

text.p: The undersecretary at the prime minister's office clarified that the Italian government plans 15 trillion lire of total spending cuts in next year's budget and this is not the amount planned just for the welfare sector.

Italian radio said undersecretary Enrico Micheli confirmed that 15 trillion lire of spending cuts referred to by Labour Minister Tiziano Treu on Tuesday meant all cuts, not just those intended for the welfare spending.
Treu himself clarified the amount at a meeting with trade unions late on Tuesday, ahead of talks starting on Wednesday.
